targets.abi: fastcall(void* self in ECX, void* unused_edx in EDX, uint value on stack), RET 4, void; preserves EBX,ESI,EDI,EBP,ESP
targets.summary: Reads REVERSE arena word 0x00657430; forward mode starts at index count-1 and steps down comparing signed [table+idx*8] and [table+idx*8+8]; reverse mode starts at index 0, compares signed [table+idx*8+8] and [table+idx*8+0x10] and steps up while next index < count-2. Each probed index is stored to [self+4]. C++ reproduces the same signed compares, index writes and table reads.

targets.abi: fastcall(void* self in ECX), RET 0, void; PUSH ESI/POP ESI, preserves EBX,ESI,EDI,EBP,ESP
targets.summary: Stores raw vtable VA 0x005b3c94 into [self]; walks [self+4] then [node+8] siblings, calls vtable+4 of a non-null [node+4] child, reloads [node+8] after that call, and finally calls vtable+4 of the last sibling. Each call uses ECX=node, one stack dword 1 and callee RET 4.

boundaries: 0044fc30 comparison uses the full 0x40-byte receiver, full 0x400-byte bound table, arena word, ordered call absence and nonvolatile/stack ABI; EAX is a volatile scratch result and is not compared.
0053f120 comparison uses ordered tagged vtable calls, one stack argument per call, full receiver and 8-node state, raw vtable-immediate check plus nonvolatile/stack ABI.

The raw vtable immediate 0x005b3c94 is verified before transport; the +4 dispatch slot is a controlled harness thunk supplied through caller-owned node vtable pointers, proving bounded transport rather than live virtual destructors or allocator state. Failed attempts 001 (fixed-address vtable page unavailable), 002 (double caller stack cleanup in the fastcall helper) and 003 (C++ called the vtable slot address instead of dereferencing [vtable+4]) are preserved; all were harness/production-binding defects, not algorithm divergence.
Real keyframe resources, live vtable/object state, null-receiver faults, unmasked FP, lifetime/concurrency domains and production CMake/registry integration remain open.
